Research how best-in-class cold email outreach platforms in 2025-2026 structure their dashboard and information architecture. Focus on these products: Instantly.ai, Smartlead, Apollo.io, Lemlist, Woodpecker.

Use WebSearch and WebFetch. I need concrete, specific, cited findings on:

1. TOP-LEVEL IA / SIDEBAR GROUPING — what are the main nav sections of each product's app, and how are sub-items grouped under them (e.g. what lives under "Campaigns" vs "Analytics" vs "Email Accounts/Deliverability" vs "Leads/CRM" vs "Settings"). Note any use of section headers / collapsible groups vs a flat list.

2. DASHBOARD / HOME SCREEN — what does a strong cold-email dashboard/home screen show on first load? KPIs (which specific metrics: sent, open rate, reply rate, positive reply rate, bounce, opportunities, revenue), funnel visualizations, sender/domain health widgets, recent activity feeds, warmup status.

3. ONBOARDING / SETUP-CHECKLIST patterns — how do these tools guide brand-new users (setup checklists, guided wizards, "connect your first inbox" flows, progress bars, empty states).

4. 6-10 concrete features or UX improvements that a newer/smaller cold-email tool commonly lacks, ranked by impact (e.g. unified inbox/master inbox, deliverability/spam-test, inbox rotation, warmup, A/Z testing, CRM/opportunity tracking, unibox reply management, blocklist/domain health monitoring, spintax, AI personalization).

Cite sources briefly (URL + one phrase) for each major claim. Return a concise, structured markdown report — this feeds a real dashboard redesign, so be specific and actionable, not generic. Do not just say "they have a dashboard" — say what's ON it.

content.content:
# Smartlead Master Inbox Sidebar Navigation

The Master Inbox sidebar contains 8 main navigation items:

1. **Inbox** - Displays "all the leads that have replied to sent campaigns"

2. **Assigned me** - Shows lead actions and activities assigned to you

3. **Sent** - Contains "all the leads you have sent emails to from campaigns"

4. **Important** - Holds leads you've marked with a star for priority follow-up

5. **Snoozed** - Features leads where you've paused notifications temporarily

6. **Reminders** - Displays emails where you've set reminder alerts

7. **Scheduled** - Shows emails queued "to be sent at a particular time"

8. **Archived** - Contains leads you've moved to archive status

Each section serves as a filter to organize and manage different lead statuses and communication workflows within the platform.

# Smartlead Main Dashboard Metrics & Columns

Based on the help documentation, the Smartlead dashboard displays these customizable columns and metrics:

## Available Metrics
- **Email Sent** — total emails dispatched across sequences
- **Opened** — "Number of unique recipients who opened at least one email"
- **Open Rate** — percentage calculation of opens
- **Clicked** — link engagement counts
- **Click Rate** — percentage of recipients clicking links
- **Replied** — response counts from leads
- **Reply Rate** — "Percentage of recipients who replied"
- **Positive Reply** — "Number of replies categorized as positive in the Master Inbox"
- **Positive Reply Rate** — portion of favorable responses
- **Bounced** — "Emails that were returned by the recipient's mail server"
- **Sender Bounced** — bounces originating from your sending domain

## Dashboard Components
The interface includes:
- Campaign list table with sortable columns
- Status, tag, and client name filtering options
- Search functionality for campaign discovery
- Folder organization view
- Column customization selector (table icon)

The documentation doesn't describe charts, widgets, or visualizations beyond the campaign metrics table itself.

# Cold Email Platform Dashboard & IA Research (2025-2026)

Findings on how Instantly, Smartlead, Apollo, Lemlist, and Woodpecker structure their apps, with what's actually on screen. Sources cited inline.

## 1. Top-level IA / sidebar grouping

**Instantly.ai** — Flat 5-item left sidebar built around the send workflow, not a settings tree:
- **Accounts** (sending infrastructure — per-mailbox health + warmup) → **Campaigns** (sequence build/launch) → **Leads** (find/upload/enrich via SuperSearch built-in DB) → **Unibox** (all replies from all inboxes aggregated) → **Analytics** (post-launch tracking). The order mirrors the user's journey: connect → build → source → reply → measure.
- Source: [instantly.ai get-started](https://instantly.ai/get-started-with-instantly/lesson-1) — "Accounts… Campaigns… Leads… Unibox… Analytics"; [vanderbuild guide](https://www.vanderbuild.co/blog/what-is-instantly-ai-and-how-can-it-help-you-scale-cold-email) — "Unibox aggregates all replies from all your inboxes into one place."

**Smartlead** — Flat left nav of modules; the current section is highlighted. Items: **Email Campaigns, Master Inbox, Email Accounts, CRM, Integrations** (plus other modules). Master Inbox has its own second-level sidebar (see §2).
- Source: [Smartlead help — sidebar](https://helpcenter.smartlead.ai/en/articles/172-side-bar-all-you-need-to-know) — "jump between Email Campaigns, Master Inbox, Email Accounts, CRM, Integrations."

**Apollo.io** — The broadest IA because it's data + engagement + CRM in one. Left nav groups: **Home** (control center overview), **Search / Prospecting** (People & Companies, filters in a left rail), **Engage** (Sequences, personalized emails, Dialer, Conversations, Meetings), **Deals/CRM**, **Analytics** (sequence performance, rep activity, pipeline stages, conversion), **Enrich/Workflows** (automation). Engagement tools are grouped together rather than flat.
- Source: [Apollo knowledge base](https://knowledge.apollo.io/hc/en-us); [techcompanynews Apollo guide](https://www.techcompanynews.com/how-to-use-apollo-io-step-by-step-guide-for-beginners/) — "home base… control center… sequences, personalized emails, the dialer, conversations, meetings, and analytics."

**Lemlist** — Multichannel-first nav with a dedicated deliverability grouping: **Campaigns** (email/LinkedIn/calls/WhatsApp/SMS in one workflow), **Leads**, **Inbox** (unified across sender + channel), **Analytics**, and a **Deliverability Hub** section that nests **lemwarm | Warm-up**. Notably groups warmup + mailbox/domain health under one "Deliverability Hub" header rather than scattering them.
- Source: [lemlist Deliverability Hub help](https://help.lemlist.com/en/articles/13751256-monitor-deliverability-with-lemlist-deliverability-hub); [lemlist review](https://www.lemlist.com/blog/lemlist-review) — "left navigation, click Deliverability hub… lemwarm | Warm-up."

**Woodpecker** — Campaign-centric with a strong dedicated deliverability toolkit surfaced as its own area (Bounce Shield, Adaptive Sending, ESP Matching, warm-up, Deliverability Monitor), plus inbox-rotation controls at the account level.
- Source: [connectsafely Woodpecker review](https://connectsafely.ai/articles/woodpecker-review-cold-email-platform-2026); [trulyinbox Woodpecker review](https://www.trulyinbox.com/blog/woodpecker-review/).

**IA takeaway for the redesign:** the strong pattern is a *flat, journey-ordered* top nav (Accounts/Infrastructure → Campaigns → Leads → Inbox → Analytics), with deliverability/warmup consolidated under ONE header (lemlist's "Deliverability Hub" is the cleanest model), and Settings kept out of the primary nav.

## 2. Dashboard / home screen — what's actually on it

**Smartlead main dashboard** is the most concrete reference. It's a **campaign table with per-column KPIs** plus top controls:
- Metrics/columns: **Email Sent, Opened, Open Rate, Clicked, Click Rate, Replied, Reply Rate, Positive Reply, Positive Reply Rate, Bounced, Sender Bounced.** "Opened" is defined as unique recipients who opened ≥1 email; "Positive Reply" = replies categorized positive in Master Inbox.
- Top controls: **column selector** (table icon, choose which metrics show), **filter** (funnel — by status/tag/client name), **campaign search**, **Create Campaign** button, folder organization view.
- Source: [Smartlead dashboard analytics](https://helpcenter.smartlead.ai/en/articles/100-main-dashboard-analytics-explanation).

**Instantly** dashboard surfaces both email KPIs and pipeline: open rate, reply rate, click/open engagement; plus an **Opportunities view** (promising prospects), **pipeline value, closing rates, sales-cycle duration, meeting-booking rates**, goal tracking (monthly/quarterly progress). The **Email Accounts dashboard** shows per-mailbox health, warmup status, and spam placement at a glance, with **colored flame warmup indicators** (basic/standard/premium tiers).
- Source: [instantly features](https://instantly.ai/blog/instantly-features/); [fahimai Instantly guide](https://www.fahimai.com/how-to-use-instantly-ai) — "email account dashboard shows per-mailbox health, warmup status, and spam placement at a glance."

**Lemlist** home is a **customizable widget dashboard** — add widgets, headings, text; widgets range from lead analysis to email performance and call-activity analysis. Core metrics: open, reply, click, unsubscribe rates and **funnel stages**, breakable by **sender, campaign, channel, or lead activity**.
- Source: [saleshandy lemlist review](https://www.saleshandy.com/blog/lemlist-review/); [lemlist review](https://www.lemlist.com/blog/lemlist-review).

**Lemlist Deliverability Hub** (best-in-class health widget set): **Total sent, Delivered + delivery rate, Not delivered (Bounced) + bounce rate, Avg daily sent**; delivery-vs-bounce trend over time; breakdowns by provider/mailbox/recipient domain; warm-up **Deliverability Score, Inbox Rate, Inbox Count, Spam Count** with score trend per mailbox and domain; **inbox placement test** results (primary vs promotions vs spam) by Google/Microsoft/SMTP, kept in a historical table.
- Source: [lemlist Deliverability Hub help](https://help.lemlist.com/en/articles/13751256-monitor-deliverability-with-lemlist-deliverability-hub).

**Reply-management inbox (Master Inbox / Unibox)** — treated as a primary screen, styled like a familiar email client. Smartlead's Master Inbox second-level sidebar: **Inbox, Assigned to me, Sent, Important (starred), Snoozed, Reminders, Scheduled, Archived**; recent additions include reply categorization and bulk actions.
- Source: [Smartlead sidebar help](https://helpcenter.smartlead.ai/en/articles/172-side-bar-all-you-need-to-know); [Smartlead master inbox features](https://www.smartlead.ai/blog/master-inbox-new-features).

**Dashboard takeaway:** a strong first load = (a) a **KPI row** with Sent, Open Rate, Reply Rate, **Positive Reply Rate**, Bounce, and **Opportunities/meetings**; (b) a **funnel** (sent → opened → replied → positive → booked); (c) a **sender/domain health widget** (warmup score, inbox vs spam placement, bounce trend) — this is what separates serious tools; (d) a **campaign table** with sortable metric columns + column selector; (e) links into the unified inbox for recent replies.

## 3. Onboarding / setup-checklist patterns

- **Goal-first wizard (Instantly):** first screen asks *what you want to accomplish* with choices (Cold email outreach, Lead generation, Campaign management, Email analytics, AI agents, Automation, Unified Inbox) — focuses onboarding on intent, not configuration. Then a linear path: connect sending infrastructure → find first leads → write + launch a campaign with AI → let the Reply Agent manage the inbox. **Empty states** do the guiding: the Leads tab shows "Add some leads to get started" with a centered **Add Leads** button. Source: [fahimai Instantly guide](https://www.fahimai.com/how-to-use-instantly-ai); [instantly get-started lesson](https://instantly.ai/get-started-with-instantly/lesson-1).
- **Connect-inbox-first (Smartlead):** account create → verify email → **Email Accounts** section to connect via Google/Microsoft/SMTP → set daily sending limit (recommends starting 30-50/day, +5-10/day) → **enable warmup on each inbox** → build + activate first campaign ("under 10 minutes"). Smartlead explicitly ships **onboarding, demos, and checklists**. Source: [Smartlead Gmail setup](https://www.smartlead.ai/blog/how-to-use-smartlead-with-gmail-for-smart-ai-driven-outreach); [Smartlead sidebar help](https://helpcenter.smartlead.ai/en/articles/172-side-bar-all-you-need-to-know).
- **General SaaS pattern worth copying:** progress-bar setup checklist that drives users to first value (connect inbox → verify DNS/DMARC → start warmup → import leads → launch first campaign), with empty states doubling as CTAs. Source: [SaaS onboarding UX examples](https://www.saasui.design/blog/saas-onboarding-ux-examples).

**Onboarding takeaway:** open with a **goal picker**, then a **persistent checklist with progress bar** whose steps are the critical path: connect first inbox → auth/DNS check → enable warmup → import leads → launch first campaign. Every empty screen should carry a single primary CTA.

## 4. Features a smaller/newer tool commonly lacks (ranked by impact)

1. **Unified / master inbox (unibox)** — all replies from every connected mailbox in one email-client-style view, with reply categorization, snooze, reminders, assignment, bulk actions. The single highest-impact table-stakes feature; all five have it. ([Smartlead master inbox](https://www.smartlead.ai/blog/master-inbox-new-features), [instantly Unibox](https://www.vanderbuild.co/blog/what-is-instantly-ai-and-how-can-it-help-you-scale-cold-email))
2. **Inbox rotation** — auto-distribute sends across many connected mailboxes to protect domain reputation; auto-shift volume when a mailbox nears its daily limit. ([Woodpecker review](https://connectsafely.ai/articles/woodpecker-review-cold-email-platform-2026), [smartlead warmup tools](https://www.smartlead.ai/blog/email-warm-up-tools-to-improve-deliverability))
3. **Built-in warmup with a health score** — gradual volume ramp on new accounts + a visible deliverability/warmup score per mailbox (flame indicators, inbox vs spam counts). ([instantly features](https://instantly.ai/blog/instantly-features/), [lemlist Deliverability Hub](https://help.lemlist.com/en/articles/13751256-monitor-deliverability-with-lemlist-deliverability-hub))
4. **Deliverability / inbox-placement + spam test** — pre-send spam checks and placement tests showing primary vs promotions vs spam, per provider (Google/Microsoft). ([lemlist Deliverability Hub](https://help.lemlist.com/en/articles/13751256-monitor-deliverability-with-lemlist-deliverability-hub), [emailwarmup best software](https://emailwarmup.com/blog/cold-email-software/best-cold-email-software-for-deliverability/))
5. **Bounce protection / domain-health monitoring** — auto-pause a campaign when bounce rate spikes (Woodpecker "Bounce Shield"), real-time sender-reputation + DNS/DMARC monitoring, Deliverability Monitor that predicts problems before they hit. ([Woodpecker review](https://connectsafely.ai/articles/woodpecker-review-cold-email-platform-2026))
6. **Positive-reply / opportunity + revenue tracking (native CRM)** — categorize replies as positive, track opportunities, pipeline value, meetings booked, closing rate. Positive-reply rate is the metric serious operators watch, not open rate. ([Smartlead dashboard](https://helpcenter.smartlead.ai/en/articles/100-main-dashboard-analytics-explanation), [instantly features](https://instantly.ai/blog/instantly-features/))
7. **A/B (A/Z) testing** — test subject lines / copy variants; often gated to higher tiers, so it's a differentiator. ([saleshandy cold email software](https://www.saleshandy.com/blog/cold-email-software/))
8. **Spintax + AI personalization** — spintax to vary subject/opening/CTA and reduce repeated wording across sends; AI-generated per-lead personalization. ([mailforge cold email tools](https://www.mailforge.ai/blog/cold-email-tools))
9. **ESP matching / adaptive sending** — align sender ESP to recipient ESP and throttle send frequency to provider limits automatically. ([Woodpecker review](https://connectsafely.ai/articles/woodpecker-review-cold-email-platform-2026))
10. **Analytics segmentation** — break every metric down by sender, campaign, channel, or lead activity, plus a customizable widget dashboard. ([lemlist review](https://www.lemlist.com/blog/lemlist-review))

**Priority for a Nxeon-scale build:** #1 unified inbox, #3 warmup-with-score, and #4/#5 deliverability + bounce/domain-health monitoring are the features whose *absence* most flags a tool as amateur; #6 positive-reply/opportunity tracking is what makes the dashboard feel results-oriented rather than vanity-metric-oriented.

- Smartlead dashboard metric list: https://helpcenter.smartlead.ai/en/articles/100-main-dashboard-analytics-explanation
- Smartlead sidebar + master-inbox IA: https://helpcenter.smartlead.ai/en/articles/172-side-bar-all-you-need-to-know
